catalog.title: Create and revise an editable beat or song section
catalog.summary: Translate bounded rhythmic, harmonic, and production traits into editable Session structure and MIDI, with optional Arrangement, revision, and guarded audition stages.
catalog.fallback: Return derived role/grid/section guidance and identify each unavailable stage. Never claim that Live contains or played the result.

stages.announcement: Discovering the Set, empty slots, tempo, scenes, devices, and stopped playback.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Require a fresh epoch, exact target refs, an empty slot, and authoritative playback state.
stages.recovery: No mutation occurred; refresh status and refs when state changed.
stages.unavailableFallback: Return the derived editable draft only and ask the operator to configure read/discovery support.

stages.announcement: Deriving bounded grid, role, section, and note guidance from allowlisted high-level traits.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Show recognized traits, excluded identity/copy intent, bar/note bounds, and any clarification requirement.
stages.recovery: Revise high-level traits without touching Live.
stages.unavailableFallback: This local planning stage is always available.

stages.announcement: Previewing exact Session structure and MIDI targets without mutation.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Show exact proposed tracks/scenes/slot, editable notes, revisions, and impact.
stages.recovery: Discard or revise either preview independently.
stages.unavailableFallback: Keep a local role/grid/section draft and name unavailable creation operations.

stages.announcement: Awaiting separate fixed apply confirmations before creating structure and MIDI.

authorities.note: Each fresh preview is confirmed separately with the literal apply phrase and a new idempotency key.
Undo each applied structure/MIDI transaction separately while its postcondition still matches.

stages.verification: Verify every created ref, parent, slot, note field, and idempotent replay result.
stages.recovery: Use guarded undo with the matching transaction while its postcondition remains exact.
stages.unavailableFallback: Do not issue an apply or claim creation; present the preview as instructions only.

stages.announcement: Optionally previewing and duplicating the exact created section into Arrangement.

authorities.note: Confirm the exact duplication preview with apply and a new idempotency key.
Cleanup is available only through the matching duplicate transaction while its created identity and fingerprint remain exact.

stages.verification: Read the exact retained Arrangement clip ref, source relationship, position, length, parent, name, fingerprint, and revision.
stages.recovery: Use guarded undo only for the exact transaction-created Arrangement clip. Arbitrary Arrangement deletion is refused because deleted clip state cannot be reconstructed.
stages.unavailableFallback: Keep the section in Session and label Arrangement duplication unavailable.

stages.announcement: Optionally replanning after duplication to move the retained section and prove transaction-owned temporary cleanup.

authorities.note: Confirm each move or temporary create preview independently with apply and a new idempotency key.
Delete only through the exact transaction that created the temporary clip; no arbitrary delete preview is available.

stages.verification: Verify the retained section's exact moved identity and position, and verify transaction-owned temporary cleanup is absent.
stages.recovery: Undo the exact unchanged move or transaction-owned create. Refuse arbitrary Arrangement deletion and report manual recovery when ownership/fingerprint no longer matches.
stages.unavailableFallback: Retain the duplicated section at its original position and provide manual move guidance.

stages.announcement: Optionally awaiting separate output-safety confirmation before one bounded audition.

authorities.note: Use the distinct unpredictable launch and owned-stop tokens returned by the same unexpired preview.
Independent stop requires exact freshly observed expected targets.

stages.verification: Verify one preflighted target becomes fired/playing and then returns to the stopped baseline.
stages.recovery: Use the owning stop token; if ownership is unavailable, use exact fresh emergency targets.
stages.unavailableFallback: Do not start playback; provide visual/text inspection guidance.

stages.announcement: Optionally previewing one bounded editable note revision after inspection or audition.

authorities.note: Confirm the exact stable note-ID preview with the literal apply phrase and a new idempotency key.
Undo requires the matching applied transaction and a new idempotency key.

stages.verification: Read notes back by stable IDs and compare every supported changed field.
stages.recovery: Guardedly undo only while those note postconditions still match.
stages.unavailableFallback: Describe the revision without claiming it was written.

stages.announcement: Reading final authoritative state and reporting every residual.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Report created refs, notes, Arrangement state, playback/recording state, and unresolved uncertainty.
stages.recovery: If readback is absent or contradictory, report uncertain and never replay a mutation blindly.
stages.unavailableFallback: Report that Live completion cannot be verified.

catalog.title: Sequence expressive and probabilistic drums
catalog.summary: Derive an editable bounded role pattern with fractional timing, probability, velocity/release variation, and explicit unsupported expressive fields.
catalog.fallback: Return role/grid guidance and omit unsupported note fields. Never relabel velocity or timing as MPE, groove extraction, or per-note modulation.

stages.announcement: Discovering drum pads, stable note support, clip target, tempo, and grid.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Resolve exact pad pitches from authoritative pad/device data or ask the operator; never guess a mapping.
stages.recovery: No mutation occurred.
stages.unavailableFallback: Return role names with pitch unset and manual mapping instructions.

stages.announcement: Deriving a bounded editable drum pattern and variation from allowlisted traits.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Cap at sixteen bars/512 notes and expose role, fractional start, duration, velocity, probability, deviation, and release intent separately.
stages.recovery: Revise density, timing, or variation locally.
stages.unavailableFallback: This local planning stage is always available.

stages.announcement: Previewing an exact empty clip target and supported drum note fields.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Show exact slot/ref, normalized notes, unsupported fields, and bounds.
stages.recovery: Discard or revise the preview.
stages.unavailableFallback: Return the editable role pattern without a Live write claim.

stages.announcement: Awaiting fixed apply confirmation before writing the exact drum clip.

authorities.note: Confirm the exact MIDI preview with apply and a new idempotency key.
Undo requires the matching transaction.

stages.verification: Read notes back with server-assigned stable IDs and compare supported fields.
stages.recovery: Guardedly undo the transaction-created clip while its identity still matches.
stages.unavailableFallback: Do not write; provide manual note entry guidance.

stages.announcement: Optionally previewing probability, timing, velocity, deviation, release, and mute changes by stable note ID.

authorities.note: Confirm exact note IDs/revisions with the literal apply phrase and a new idempotency key.
Undo requires the matching revision-safe transaction.

stages.verification: Read back each advertised field; leave unsupported values explicitly unavailable.
stages.recovery: Undo only unchanged transaction-owned note updates.
stages.unavailableFallback: Keep expressive values as manual guidance; do not claim MPE or unavailable fields.

stages.announcement: Optionally awaiting output-safety confirmation for one exact clip audition.

authorities.note: Use distinct unpredictable launch/owned-stop tokens.
Use only with exact fresh targets.

stages.verification: Verify only the exact clip is active and then stopped.
stages.recovery: Use owned clip stop or exact emergency stop.
stages.unavailableFallback: Do not audition; inspect notes textually or in Live manually.

stages.announcement: Reading final drum notes, playback state, and residuals.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Report exact clip/note refs, field values, and stopped state if audition occurred.
stages.recovery: Contradictory readback is uncertain; do not rewrite blindly.
stages.unavailableFallback: Report that the Live write cannot be verified.

catalog.title: Design a sound with available native or owned devices
catalog.summary: Derive topology/control directions, select one stable Browser result, optionally edit published parameters, audition safely, and compare authoritative before/after state.
catalog.fallback: Provide topology, preset, and manual-control guidance. Never claim plug-in UI control, ownership, loading, or verification without an advertised API and authoritative readback.

stages.announcement: Discovering Browser results and current topology without assuming a device exists.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Use stable Browser IDs and exact track/device refs; distinguish native, pack, Max, and plug-in categories.
stages.recovery: No mutation occurred.
stages.unavailableFallback: Return semantic topology/control guidance and manual Browser instructions.

stages.announcement: Deriving bounded topology and semantic control directions from allowlisted sonic traits.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Explain rationale without promising an acoustic outcome; controls remain semantic until published refs/bounds exist.
stages.recovery: Revise high-level sonic traits locally.
stages.unavailableFallback: This local planning stage is always available.

stages.announcement: Previewing one selected stable Browser result on an exact track.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Show stable result ID, exact target track, expected device identity, and cleanup operation.
stages.recovery: Discard the preview or choose another result.
stages.unavailableFallback: Do not claim load; provide manual selection guidance.

stages.announcement: Awaiting fixed apply confirmation before loading one device.

authorities.note: Confirm the exact Browser preview with apply and a new idempotency key.
Undo deletes only the transaction-created exact device.

stages.verification: Rediscover and verify exact device parentage/class/enabled state; capabilities may change after load.
stages.recovery: Guardedly remove only the transaction-created device.
stages.unavailableFallback: Do not issue a load or claim a device was created.

stages.announcement: Optionally previewing one bounded published parameter change after rediscovery.

authorities.note: Use the unpredictable token tied to one exact enabled parameter/ref/value/revision.
Undo requires the same transaction and unchanged postcondition.

stages.verification: Verify exact parentage, enabled state, bounds, quantization, value, and revision.
stages.recovery: Undo that parameter only; never automate an unpublished plug-in UI control.
stages.unavailableFallback: Present semantic manual adjustment guidance and label published parameter control unavailable.

stages.announcement: Optionally awaiting output-safety confirmation for a bounded before/after audition.

authorities.note: Use distinct unpredictable launch and stop tokens.
Independent stop requires exact fresh targets.

stages.verification: Compare authoritative settings; device presence is context, not causal audio proof.
stages.recovery: Stop exact playback and restore the prior parameter/topology through its own transaction.
stages.unavailableFallback: Do not play; use authoritative parameter/topology readback only.

stages.announcement: Reading final topology, parameters, playback state, and residuals.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Report exact created device, changed parameter if any, playback state, and unsupported controls.
stages.recovery: Contradictory state is uncertain; do not reload or rewrite blindly.
stages.unavailableFallback: Report that Live topology cannot be verified.

catalog.title: Compare a project section with a user-supplied reference
catalog.summary: Analyze authorized caller PCM, align and level-match within bounds, optionally connect measured differences to fresh Live context/capture, and test one reversible hypothesis without claiming causality.
catalog.fallback: Local standards/reference comparison remains available without Live. Label Live attribution unavailable and request explicit consent/provenance instead of inventing signal-chain evidence.

stages.announcement: Establishing that project/reference PCM is caller-supplied or generated and permitted for this analysis.

authorities.note: The caller supplies PCM and source relationship; this does not prove copyright ownership or legal clearance.

stages.verification: Record source relationship in the request without storing source paths or raw PCM in results.
stages.recovery: Cancel the disposable worker; no raw result is returned.
stages.unavailableFallback: This local stage is always available for bounded caller PCM.

stages.announcement: Measuring bounded loudness, true peak, dynamics, spectrum, transients, and alignment.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Report standards versions, raw-audio privacy, alignment confidence/overlap, level match, and unavailable measurements.
stages.recovery: Use manual or disabled alignment when automatic alignment is ambiguous.
stages.unavailableFallback: This local stage is always available for supported PCM.

stages.announcement: Optionally linking measurements to fresh exact Live context without claiming device causality.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Separate measured facts, observed topology, declared source relationship, and hypotheses.
stages.recovery: Keep the result local-only when Live context is unavailable or stale.
stages.unavailableFallback: Report measurement-only advice with no Live attribution.

stages.announcement: Optionally awaiting consent and exact confirmation for one ephemeral Live Resampling capture.

authorities.note: Use the unpredictable token for the exact source/destination/duration/route/epoch preview.
Independent capture recovery uses the literal emergency-stop-and-clean phrase and exact recovery identity.

stages.verification: Require stopped playback/recording, restored route/arm/monitoring, deleted owned clip, absent WAV/ASD/quarantine, and no raw output.
stages.recovery: From a fresh host, inspect status and call capture emergency stop; Session playback emergency stop is not capture cleanup.
stages.unavailableFallback: Use caller-supplied PCM only and label Live capture unavailable.

stages.announcement: Optionally previewing one reversible mixer hypothesis before same-scope remeasurement.

authorities.note: Confirm one exact bounded mixer-row preview with the literal apply phrase and a new idempotency key.
Restore the exact prior mixer state with the matching transaction.

stages.verification: Restore the control and compare same-scope aggregate measurements; call it a hypothesis, never causality.
stages.recovery: Restore fresh authoritative mixer state and report uncertainty when recapture scope differs.
stages.unavailableFallback: Return measurement-led manual guidance without claiming a Live adjustment.

stages.announcement: Reporting measurement facts, text alternatives, confidence, advice, and every residual.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Include loudness/peak/dynamics/spectrum/transient text, alignment confidence, privacy, and Live attribution limits.
stages.recovery: If an optional capture or mutation is uncertain, do not call the journey complete until status/recovery reports residuals.
stages.unavailableFallback: This local reporting stage is always available.

catalog.title: Diagnose a mix, recording, or performance setup
catalog.summary: Aggregate authoritative playback, routing, monitoring, arm, mixer, recording, device, subscription, and realtime recovery readiness before proposing guarded fixes.
catalog.fallback: Return a read-only risk checklist with exact missing capabilities. Never arm, monitor, record, route, play, or claim low-latency readiness when authority is absent.

stages.announcement: Reading playback, arm, monitoring, routing, mixer, device, automation, project, and recovery readiness.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Rank exact-ref/revision/provenance findings; unavailable measured latency remains unknown.
stages.recovery: No mutation occurred; if mapper-owned playback is already active, use only exact owned/emergency authority.
stages.unavailableFallback: Return a manual read-only feedback/clipping/arm/monitoring/latency checklist.

stages.announcement: Previewing bounded routing and mixer fixes with audible/feedback impact and recovery.

authorities.note: Read-only; grants no Live mutation authority.

stages.verification: Show exact before/after route/mixer rows, feedback refusal, revisions, and independent recovery.
stages.recovery: Discard previews when monitoring, output safety, refs, or stop authority is unclear.
stages.unavailableFallback: Keep findings read-only and identify routing/mixer operations that need manual action.

stages.announcement: Optionally awaiting separate exact confirmations for each routing or mixer fix.

authorities.note: Confirm each purpose-specific preview separately with the literal apply phrase and its own idempotency key.
Restore each exact transaction independently.

stages.verification: Verify each route/mixer mutation independently before another consequential action.
stages.recovery: Undo exact unchanged rows and report any residual feedback/monitoring risk.
stages.unavailableFallback: Do not mutate; provide exact manual steps.

stages.announcement: Optionally awaiting recording intent and exact confirmation for one bounded recording lifecycle.

authorities.note: Confirm exact mode/destination/arm/monitoring/playback preconditions with the literal apply phrase and a new idempotency key.
Independent playback/recording stop requires exact fresh targets/state.

stages.verification: Verify start and stop, exact destination/clip or Arrangement state, and restored arm/monitoring/transport.
stages.recovery: Stop exact recording, restore routing/arm/monitoring, and report created media/clips.
stages.unavailableFallback: Do not arm or record; return a manual preflight checklist.

stages.announcement: Optionally awaiting short-lived realtime authority for exact channels, ports, and parameters.

authorities.note: Confirm exact TTL/channels/source ports/parameter refs with the literal apply phrase and a new idempotency key.
Immediately revoke realtime authority with the literal disarm phrase.
Emergency stop remains independent of UDP token state.

stages.verification: Distinguish accepted/applied/dropped counters and verify expiry/disarm plus stopped state.
stages.recovery: Disarm immediately and use independent authenticated TCP emergency stop.
stages.unavailableFallback: Do not claim low-latency control; use bounded request/response tools.

stages.announcement: Reading final routing, mixer, recording, playback, realtime authority, and residual state.

authorities.note: Realtime stats evidence is carried forward only when the optional realtime stage was available.

stages.verification: Report exact rows/refs, transport/recording, authority expiry/disarm, and every residual.
stages.recovery: Contradictory/missing state is uncertain; use fresh discovery and only independently authorized stop.
stages.unavailableFallback: Report that final Live state cannot be verified.
